## Project Summary

Next.js 14 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS dashboard with Neo Minimalist Clear design:
pure white / slate-50 backgrounds, 1px neutral-200 borders, no drop shadows, Inter font, lucide-react icons.

- Core Modules (blue dot): PMB, Keuangan, KRS, Operasional Perkuliahan — scheduled before academic events.
- Support Modules (gray dot): SPMI, OBE, CBT, Karirlink, Kepegawaian, Kemahasiswaan, Akreditasi, Litabmas, Simkerma — scheduled in quiet gaps.

Run with `npm run dev` (task: "dev: aldi-planner").
